canonical_report.command: jq -r '.measures | "matching_functions=\(.matched_functions) matching_objects=\(.complete_units) matching_code_bytes=\(.matched_code) linked_code_bytes=\(.complete_code) code_percent=\(.matched_code_percent)"' build/GEDE01/report.json

range_accounting.command: python3 -c 'import json; frontier=json.load(open("reports/GEDE01/session-2012-verification.json")); matched=json.load(open("build/GEDE01/session-2012-remediation-2-fn_801FB9C8-canonical.json")); nonmatching=json.load(open("build/GEDE01/session-2012-remediation-2-fn_801FB6A4-canonical.json")); mb=int(next(x["size"] for x in matched["left"]["symbols"] if x["name"]=="fn_801FB9C8")); nb=int(next(x["size"] for x in nonmatching["left"]["symbols"] if x["name"]=="fn_801FB6A4")); rb=int(frontier["range_end"],16)-int(frontier["range_start"],16); print(f"range_bytes={rb} matched_bytes={mb} nonmatching_bytes={nb} accounted_bytes={mb+nb} range_accounting_complete={str(rb==mb+nb).lower()}")'

dol_identity.command: sha1sum build/GEDE01/main.dol orig/GEDE01/sys/main.dol; cmp -s build/GEDE01/main.dol orig/GEDE01/sys/main.dol; printf 'cmp_exit=%s\n' "$?"
